summary: Form 8-K filed by Ares Sports, Media & Entertainment Opportunities LP reporting unregistered sales of equity units under Item 3.02 and transactional net asset value disclosure under Item 8.01. On April 1, 2026, the Fund sold 359,184 Class I, 675,532 Class A-S, 64,070 Class A-D, and 260,990 Class A-I units for aggregate consideration of $38.1 million, priced at transactional NAV as of March 31, 2026. Sales were made to accredited investors/qualified purchasers via Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D, including through a feeder vehicle. This is a routine continuous private offering, not a special situation; cumulative proceeds total ~$742 million. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock noted. No risk-arb angle; purely capital-raising disclosure.
